summary: Phase 7.2 NFT E2E: HARD BLOCKED at T1 (wallet provisioning). Both current active preview origins (https://proyek-continue.preview.emergentagent.com and https://proyek-continue.preview.emergentagent.com) surface data-testid='wallet-chip-error' on /profile with identical Privy console errors ('Origin not allowed' + CSP frame-ancestors block on https://auth.privy.io/). CSP header reveals the ONLY allowlisted frame-ancestors for Privy iframe are: https://proyek-continue.preview.emergentagent.com, https://proyek-continue.preview.emergentagent.com, https://code-sync-portal-2.preview.static.emergentagent.com, https://repo-setup-144.emergent.host, https://auth.privy.io. Neither of the two candidate URLs the user asked us to try is in that list, and probing the first allowlisted URL returns 'Preview Unavailable' (dead pod). Because Privy embedded wallet cannot authenticate JWT->wallet on this origin, ALL wallet-dependent scenarios (T2 mint/approve/register, T3 on-chain verify via user signed tx, T4 auction-room live wallet state, T5 bidding, T6 anti-snipe extending via new bid, T7 close winner detection through cron flow triggered by live auction, T8 settle(), T9 refund withdrawal, T10 collection re-read of ownerOf, T11-T12 send NFT + post-transfer ownership) cannot proceed without user action. Non-wallet spot checks that ARE green: signed-out Home + /explore render fine; /create page loads for signed-in Seller A with 'type' <select> containing options 'Physical', 'NFT (on-chain)', 'Digital (non-NFT) — Coming Soon' (NFT option present as expected); /profile MyActivity Collection tab exists with correct testid 'activity-tab-collection' and shows the empty state 'No NFTs yet — create an NFT auction or win one to build your collection.' when Seller A has no NFTs. This exactly repeats the iteration_1 blocker on 7.2 — the app code is fine, the Privy dashboard allowlist is out of date.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Privy application (App ID cmu739eqk00fk0dlbr0m5ubxu) 'Allowed Origins' list is stale. The three configured origins are dead/inactive Emergent preview pods (57f7ac7d-... returns 'Preview Unavailable', code-sync-portal-2 is a different project) plus the backend host (repo-setup-144.emergent.host, useless for iframe). REPRODUCTION: (a) Load https://proyek-continue.preview.emergentagent.com or https://proyek-continue.preview.emergentagent.com in a fresh browser context. (b) Password-grant supabase login as sellera@bztest.dev and inject session into localStorage key 'sb-ialusnghydghsykekgeb-auth-token'. (c) Navigate to /profile and wait >=10s. (d) Observe wallet-chip-error rendered and console messages 'r: Origin not allowed' + "Framing 'https://auth.privy.io/' violates ... CSP frame-ancestors ...". MITIGATION: User must add current preview origin(s) to Privy dashboard Allowed Origins; no code change needed. WORKAROUND (not viable for testing): none — Privy iframe cannot be spoofed and origin is enforced server-side by Privy at authenticate() call.
